system.notes: 1 point per improvement: hold breath underwater +20 seconds; swimming distance +0.1 to the multiplier; swimming fatigue +1 (normally Body ÷ 2); treading water +1 minute between tests and −1 to its Damage Resistance TN; floating −1 to Buoyancy and Treading Water tests (not damage resistance) and +1 Body for how long the character can float.
